name: Slissima
text: Slissima is a character of James Macpherson's Ossian, the poems published between 1760 and 1763. The poem makes her the sister of Cuchullin and the mother of Althan and Ardar.

attributes.attribute: sister of Cuchullin in Macpherson's Ossian
